meta.title: NOSTALGIA Map v2 - real road alignments (Hyderabad, set in 2003)
meta.author: geo researcher (roads/water/rail/terrain)
meta.format: pts are [lat, lon] WGS84, 5 decimals (~1 m, not a claim of 1 m accuracy: OSM street centrelines are typically good to 2-10 m); lanes = total lanes both directions (2003 estimate); divided = painted/raised median in 2003 (estimate).
meta.method: Every road was routed with a shortest-path search over OpenStreetMap street geometry (Overture Maps transportation release 2026-09-23.0, OSM-sourced segments only) between junction waypoints, preferring OSM ways with the road's real name; then simplified with Douglas-Peucker (4 m tolerance, raised until <= 60 vertices; short roads resampled to >= 5 points along the real line). Post-2003 structures (PVNR expressway, steel bridges, Durgam Cheruvu cable bridge, ORR) were excluded; other flyovers were penalised so the at-grade road is used where it exists (era_note marks the few places where only the flyover alignment exists in today's data). Ward sequences come from DataMeet GHMC ward polygons and were checked against expected neighbourhoods (ward_check).

confidence_rules.high: alignment taken from OSM data for the road of that name (or the named bridge way)
confidence_rules.medium: alignment from OSM data, but the game road is mapped to a representative real street, or the road is partly unnamed in OSM, or its identity/era is inferred
confidence_rules.low: estimated by the researcher (path geometry or identity not in the data); see note

attribution: Map reference: DataMeet Municipal Spatial Data (CC BY 4.0) and (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
Road geometry: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, distributed via Overture Maps Foundation (transportation theme, release 2026-09-23.0)
Cross-checks: OSM extract of Hyderabad district (github.com/shivakumar-ui-max/hyderabad-gis-map, data (c) OSM contributors, ODbL)
caveats: OSM is a 2026 snapshot: alignments of 2003-era roads are unchanged in nearly all cases, but widths, medians and some names changed; flyovers were not there in 2003 except old rail overbridges (Begumpet, Lalaguda, Moula Ali).
Colony lanes in the game have generic names (ln_*); each is mapped to a real street of that neighbourhood (real_name).
Old City lanes are partly unnamed in OSM; identities there are by position (confidence medium/low).
